statement: At least one oil refinery inside Russia, excluding occupied Ukrainian territory, is struck by a Ukrainian drone or missile between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: Reuters, AP or BBC report, or the Russian Defense Ministry or a Russian regional governor states, that a named refinery in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones or missiles on a date from 2026-10-19 through 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No oil refinery inside Russia is struck by a Ukrainian drone or missile on any date from 2026-10-19 through 2026-10-25.

statement: A merchant vessel is struck by a drone, missile or naval mine inside Romanian territorial waters or the Romanian exclusive economic zone between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01, not counting the vessels reported on fire on 2026-10-15.
resolution: Romanian authorities state, or two of Reuters, AP, BBC and DW report, a new drone, missile or mine strike on a merchant ship inside Romanian waters or exclusive economic zone between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.
failure_condition: No merchant ship other than the vessels hit on 2026-10-15 is struck by a drone, missile or naval mine inside Romanian waters or its exclusive economic zone between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01.

statement: US forces use a GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb, known as the MOAB, in combat anywhere between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: A Pentagon or CENTCOM statement, corroborated by two of Reuters, AP and BBC, confirms combat employment of a GBU-43/B MOAB on a date from 2026-10-19 through 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No GBU-43/B MOAB is employed in combat by US forces on any date from 2026-10-19 through 2026-12-31.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range at its meeting ending 2026-10-28. Reference: upper bound of 4.00 percent in effect on the packet date 2026-10-15.
resolution: The FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 on federalreserve.gov sets a target range whose upper bound is above 4.00 percent.
failure_condition: The upper bound of the federal funds target range announced at the conclusion of the meeting ending 2026-10-28 is 4.00 percent or lower.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield for 2026-11-20 is at or above 5.25 percent. Reference: 5.05 percent in the packet market snapshot of 2026-10-15.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 reports a value of 5.25 or higher for observation date 2026-11-20, as retrieved on or after 2026-11-25.
failure_condition: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield for 2026-11-20 is below 5.25 percent.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite records a daily close below 24000 on at least one trading day between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 26611.73 in the packet market snapshot of 2026-10-15.
resolution: FRED series NASDAQCOM shows a daily closing value below 24000 for any observation date from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-20 inclusive, as retrieved on or after 2026-11-25.
failure_condition: Every Nasdaq Composite daily close from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-20 is at or above 24000.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one Langflow entry with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-15 and 2026-11-05.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed carries an entry whose vendorProject or product field is Langflow and whose dateAdded value falls from 2026-10-15 through 2026-11-05 inclusive.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Langflow vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value from 2026-10-15 through 2026-11-05.

statement: USGS records an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with Panama in its place name and an origin time between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01 UTC.
resolution: A USGS ComCat query for magnitude 6.0 or greater with origin time from 2026-10-19T00:00Z through 2026-11-01T23:59Z returns at least one event whose place field contains Panama.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with Panama in its USGS place name has an origin time between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-01 UTC.

statement: Democrats win at least 218 of the 435 seats in the US House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: As of 2026-11-20, Associated Press tallies for the 2026-11-03 election show Democrats have won or lead in at least 218 of 435 House races; leaders in uncalled races count as winners.
failure_condition: Democrats win or lead in fewer than 218 of the 435 House races as of 2026-11-20.

statement: The US military executes Nidal Malik Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter, between 2026-12-03 and 2026-12-10.
resolution: The Army or Pentagon announces, and at least two of AP, Reuters and BBC report, that Hasan was executed on a date from 2026-12-03 through 2026-12-10.
failure_condition: Hasan is not executed on any date from 2026-12-03 through 2026-12-10, whether because of a stay, postponement, commutation or cancellation.
